evals.prompt: Build a constant-speed portrait product orbit at 1080x1920 with a readable logo.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Fits actual sensor/aspect and checks critical evaluated points over motion.
Corrects tracking/up-axis and constant-speed interpolation deliberately.
Keeps sharp diagnostic and focus treatment separate and preserves source animation.

evals.prompt: An overhead target camera flips and crops after a portrait aspect change. Repair it without touching the product animation.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis tied to the supplied failure, preserved sources, a concrete correction and repeated affected acceptance checks.
assertions: Fits actual sensor/aspect and checks critical evaluated points over motion.
Corrects tracking/up-axis and constant-speed interpolation deliberately.
Keeps sharp diagnostic and focus treatment separate and preserves source animation.
Does not label a hypothetical plan, a structural assertion or unrun workflow as successful execution.
